repetetive and boring.

This review starts with a song: Imperium's Dream by Colm R. McGuinness. If you don't know him, you are a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ heretic and deserve to be cleansed in flame. If you know him, but never listened to that song, go fix this mistake.
Than come back and tell me you aren't filled with righteous wrath and all pumped to purge some heathens.

The thing is, in 30 years of gaming I never played a Warhammer 40k game. Not once.
But this music masterpiece made me realize the errors of my way and I also realized I have Space Marine in my library.
So I installed it and, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, it's ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ awesome for an action game that came out almost 15 years ago.
The graphics are dated, but hold up surprisingly well.
The story is nothing spectacular and the voice acting is bland, but holy ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ thunder hammer, the combat is SO SATISFYING. The sounds, the feel, the weapons, the screen shaking, everything fills you with righteous vengeance.

Install this game and go bash some skulls right now.

THIS REVIEW HAS BEEN WRITTEN IN GOD EMPEROR'S NAME.

Dis game’s a right propa krumpin’ good time! From da outside, it might look like just anuvver humie shoota from da old days, but lemme tell ya, fer us Warhammer 40K boyz, dis one’s a zoggin’ gem! Stompin’ around in dem big shiny Space Marine boots, bashin’ up da ladz, givin’ Chaos gitz a good whackin’ -it’s like Gork ‘n Mork kissed da screen! Da multiplayer ain’t half bad neither, got me shoutin’ and shootin’ all night! I gives it a solid 7.5 outta 10 teef, and dat’s sayin’ sumfin!
Excellent Space Marine Game. Brutal combat with intense sound design and visuals.
